topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Evolution and Lecture Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: It provides the introductory framing, contextual background, and learning outcomes for the lecture.

topics.label: Genetic Selection and Epigenetic Regulation in Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how successive genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer competitive growth advantages that drive clonal expansion.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Models
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate tissue hierarchies and evaluate experimental evidence for stem cells and tumor-propagating cells driving tumor initiation and growth.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Support, Inflammation, and Tumor Promotion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how environmental promoters, inflammatory signaling, and supportive stroma provide the permissive microenvironment required for malignant outgrowth.

topics.label: Experimental and Computational Methods for Studying Tumor Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the modern genomic sequencing, mathematical modeling, and spatial profiling technologies used to interrogate tumor evolution and cellular interactions.

topics.label: Integrated Evolutionary Model of Tumor Development
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes the lecture's concepts into a comprehensive framework where genetics, cell of origin, and microenvironmental pressures co-evolve to produce cancer.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Next Steps
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the session and previews the subsequent lecture on cancer therapies.
